description: This file defines the Doctrine class responsible for configuring and managing the Doctrine ORM EntityManager within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up database connections, cache configurations, and custom functions for ORM use. It also implements singleton behavior to ensure a single instance manages the ORM setup.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class that initializes and provides access to the Doctrine ORM EntityManager, configuring database connection, cache, and custom functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the Doctrine ORM configuration and EntityManager based on application settings.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines whether the application is running in development mode by checking the framework's debug state.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Collects and returns the entity paths from plugin directories for ORM metadata.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of the Doctrine class, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the configured Doctrine EntityManager instance.
